summary_zh: 这是freeCodeCamp.org的开源代码库与课程资源，提供免费、自定进度的全栈Web开发与机器学习课程，包含数千个互动编程挑战，以及响应式网页设计、JavaScript、Python、关系数据库、后端开发等认证路径，还提供面向开发者的语言认证。
audience_zh: 适合希望免费学习编程、数学与计算机科学的自学者，尤其是希望转入技术行业的在职成年人，以及准备通过项目与考试获得开发者认证、为求职或简历积累证明的学习者。

evidence.quote: freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
Our full-stack web development and machine learning curriculum is completely free and self-paced. We have thousands of interactive coding challenges to help you expand your skills.

[freeCodeCamp.org](https://www.freecodecamp.org) is a friendly community where you can learn to code for free.
